notes: ERT News (ertnews.gr) needs 31 days 2026-09-25..2026-10-25. Probes: robots.txt 200, permissive (disallows only /livetv/, /advert/, /ertsports/, /ertflix/, /broadcast/, /video-file/, /wp-json/), no Sitemap line. /sitemap.xml and /wp-sitemap.xml 200 -> WordPress core sitemap index with 144 wp-sitemap-posts-post-N.xml files, but they carry ONLY <loc>: no <lastmod> at all (0 occurrences in the 36 KB index, 305 KB post-1 and 120 KB post-144 files), and ERT article paths have no /YYYY/MM/DD/ segment, so the sitemap gives no publication dates. /news-sitemap.xml and /sitemap-news.xml both 404. WP REST /wp-json/ is robots-disallowed, so it was not used. Working route: WordPress date archives. /2026/10/20/ 200 (HTML, paginated /2026/10/20/page/2/), and - the route the script uses - the per-day RSS feed /YYYY/MM/DD/feed/ 200, 35 <item> per page, further pages /YYYY/MM/DD/feed/?paged=N (checked paged=2 and paged=3 on 10-20, both 200 with 35 fresh items each, strictly descending). Listed date = the archive day itself: WordPress date archives are cut on Athens local time, so the day whose feed lists an article IS the date the site states for it. Verified against the page JSON-LD on 12 re-fetched articles (4 of them the check-style samples): all 12 returned 200 and datePublished's date equalled the listed date exactly (deviation 0 days), 4.1k-5.9k characters of text. No fallback was needed, but the script still has an HTML-archive fallback (parse /YYYY/MM/DD/ and /page/N/) if a day's feed ever comes back empty. Result: 7179 unique URLs, 31/31 days, 2026-09-30=239, 2026-10-10=168, 2026-10-20=283, minimum 128 on 2026-09-27, ~500 requests in 545 s wall clock (polite_fetch 1-2 req/s). Robustness for reruns (the failure that was reported before: the script did not write its tsv when rerun, i.e. the rerun was cut off): the tsv is rewritten atomically after every completed day, so any interrupted run still leaves a valid file, and each finished day is cached in data/urls_custom/ertnews-gr.days.json so a second run finishes in about a second (delete that file to force a fresh crawl). Never re-derive dates from <lastmod> here - there is none - and never use the sitemap for dates.
